title: H4616 (124th General Assembly): Electronic identification chips installed in guns

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2021-11-17; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess124_2021-2022/prever/4616_20211117.htm (LegiScan doc 2450470))
provenance.note: Introduced version (Nov. 17, 2021); no later version or vote on file.

operative_text: Section 1 (new Section 23-31-910): Notwithstanding another provision of law, all guns manufactured in this State must be equipped with an electronic chip that identifies its owner.
